pages.text: Some functions change the world more:$(br2)$(li)MOVE_ITEMS, DELETE_ITEMS: move or remove items in containers$(li)PLACE_BLOCK, REMOVE_BLOCK: place or break blocks$(li)SPAWN_ITEM, SPAWN_ENTITY: create items and mobs$(li)TELEPORT: move an entity
Positions are given as a $(1)c0de/minecraft/POSITION$() struct with x, y, z and an optional dimension. Programs can never change the blocks on the sheets of the c0de dimension.
